description: This file defines a Review data model and a ReviewsProvider class that manages persistence and aggregation of reviews for a restaurant app. The provider interacts with a local database to add reviews, load all reviews, and compute average ratings.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: A data model representing a customer review, including fields for id, orderId, rating, comment, optional photo path, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: ReviewsProvider
classes.description: A provider class that manages reviews data, including adding new reviews, loading all reviews, and computing aggregate statistics such as average rating and total count.

methods.name: Review
methods.description: Constructor for creating a Review instance with required fields.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a review to the local database and notifies listeners.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Loads all reviews from the database, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: aggregate
methods.description: Calculates the average rating and total number of reviews.
